input.free_text_description: This system is a task management platform that serves User, Candidate roles. The platform provides capabilities for account application, custom bean factory, cassandra configuration. Secondary concerns include user management functionality.

user_stories.story: As a User, I want to receive notifications about important events, so that I can stay informed and respond promptly.
As an Admin, I want to manage system configuration and monitor operations, so that I can ensure the platform runs smoothly.
As a User, I want to interact with hystrix functionality, so that I can accomplish my hystrix-related tasks.
As a User, I want to interact with account api functionality, so that I can accomplish my account api-related tasks.
As a User, I want to interact with ticket api functionality, so that I can accomplish my ticket api-related tasks.
